comments.body: The source does not double the block bytes. mainSort copies only BZ_N_OVERSHOOT bytes after the block (blocksort.c:794-798); fallbackSort doubles its refinement depth H (blocksort.c:259-312). Please describe the actual mechanism or omit “with the block doubled.”

“The decoder’s origPtr check is only” this range test is inaccurate: it first rejects origPtr < 0 or origPtr > 10 + 100000 * blockSize100k at decompress.c:261-264, then checks origPtr >= nblock at 497-498. The earlier upper bound is redundant once a valid nblock is known, so ValidInput can stay as written; please qualify this sentence as the final/effective range condition and cite both checks.

last.summary: The BWT definitions, inverse walk, periodic examples, and source rules check out; verify.sh passes. Please correct two inaccurate descriptions of the vendored C implementation in the module documentation.
